reused_cards.question: Vilket nummer ringer du i Finland när liv eller hälsa är i omedelbar fara och hjälp behövs på plats?
Vilket särskilt stöd kan en pensionär med små inkomster ha rätt till för boendet?

blocked_candidates.reason: Resident-directed battery replacement omits the building-owner responsibility effective January 2026; testing/reporting card retained separately.
Absolute claim that an operator never transfers a call is not established and conflicts with interpretation/call-routing contexts.
Statutory rent-reduction and termination remedies do not universally require landlord agreement.
Whole-home onward letting conflates permission-based subletting with legally permitted temporary assignment and notice rules.
Residual-waste definition could include hazardous waste merely because no local bin exists; cannot publish that blanket classification.
Retail take-back duties differ for batteries, lamps and electrical equipment; universal acceptance by all sellers is not established.
Always-present adult is not established for every youth facility and opening mode; local arrangements vary.
A disputed brokerage fee is not automatically a police matter; criminal suspicion and civil fee remedies must be distinguished.
Blanket spouse/cohabitant exemption omits statutory cohabitation conditions and current acquisition restrictions. No unconditional exemption card.
Biodiversity is not simply the largest possible species count; genetic and ecosystem diversity also matter.
Names the superseded Animal Protection Act instead of the Animal Welfare Act in force since 2024.
Consumer status is not every purchase by every buyer; private-purpose and trader scope are omitted.
Source suggests a modern statutory floor-area cap for general housing allowance; current rules instead use accepted expenses and monetary caps.
Ambiguous arithmetic could imply 70 percent of costs minus the full deductible; current formula applies 70 percent to the difference.
Latin lettering alone is not the recognition test; licence categories, validity and translation/international-permit rules matter.
Expired EU/EEA licence does not grant two more years to drive; source confuses exchange/testing periods and validity.

verification_sources.findings: Residential Tenancies Act: notice, deposits, entry, repairs, remedies, tenant damage and normal wear; read current 2026 amendments.
KKV confirms contractual rent increases, normal-wear protection, defect remedies and notice requirements.
Landlord notice normally three or six months and must follow acceptable grounds/good practice.
Municipal housing guidance on shares versus real property and conditional purchase permits; spouse generalisation not published.
Defence Ministry decides permit applications and may refuse them; applying is not an entitlement to buy.
Current standard rates: housing shares 1.5 percent, real estate 3 percent.
Debt-free share price differs from real-estate consideration; no claim that all closing costs are included.
DVV move notification earliest one month before, latest one week after.
Household, assets/income, accepted costs, municipality caps, changes and student exceptions checked. No floor-area or ambiguous arithmetic card.
Distinguishes general, student, pensioner and conscript housing assistance.
State financial/debt counselling is free and offers advice rather than cash.
Private debt usually needs judgment; taxes and other specified public claims may be directly enforceable.
Income enforcement preserves statutory protected amounts.
Guarantees for bank consolidation loans require whole-situation and affordability assessment; advice is available.
2026 ministry information confirms social credit through wellbeing services counties and Helsinki.
Consumer definition and defect remedies are conditional; no immediate-universal-refund card.
Current Animal Welfare Act supersedes old title; animal-care principle retained without obsolete title.
Local sorting and material recovery; do not universalise local collection availability.
Waste-stream distinctions reviewed; hazardous, electrical and medicine waste not residual waste.
Nonempty chemical aerosols and relevant chemicals use hazardous-waste collection.
Metsahallitus lists allowed access and collection, privacy and protected-area restrictions, fires, motors and dogs. Precise seasonal dog dates not tested.
Pavement exception for under-twelve children; cycleways/roadway and safe equipment.
Motor-vehicle drink-driving threshold starts at 0.5 per mille; not a permitted level.
EU/EEA validity, convention-country two-year residence period, other recognised-country one-year period and translation requirements.
Exchange residence/study eligibility, expired EU/EEA medical certificate, convention exchange and tests.
Moving goods and imported-car customs, tax and use requirements depend on origin and exemptions.
Official Nordic guidance on conditional removal-goods duty relief and time requirements.
Rescue authority confirms alarm acquisition/maintenance shifts to building owner January 2026.
Rescue-service handbook states minimum one alarm per starting 60 square metres and per floor.
Fire-service domestic safety guidance; no water on fat fires, safe equipment and unobstructed escape.
Official 112 urgency, location and call-instruction guidance.
Emergency Response Centre service: free calls without area code and dispatch role.
Municipal library core services, card registration and local late/replacement charges.
First card free; child registration uses guardian requirements.
Municipal library service description supports reading, lending and broader services.
Municipalities, associations and adult education centres provide hobby routes; local availability qualified.

other_source_issues.reason: Question tests the offence threshold, correcting misleading permitted-level framing while preserving the source number.
Minimum per starting 60 square metres per floor, not guarantee that one alarm is sufficient in all layouts.
Real-estate tax basis uses consideration, not the apartment-share debt-free-price terminology.
Hidden-defect card distinguishes definition and possible legal liability, without automatic damages for every defect.
Repair-notice card tests advance notice and urgency exception; exact statutory inconvenience categories are not reduced to small/large labels.
Driving entitlement card retains age/health context without testing every individual licence category.
One-year period depends on population registration; no suggestion that validity extends beyond the licence itself.
Card-registration question retains local-rule qualification without universal temporary-card expiry.
Interpretation question does not promise immediate availability of every language.
Corrected duplicate link before final output; selection snapshot refreshed solely for metadata, without rescoring judgments or changing tiers.

coverage_note: Source IDs include context and consolidation links. Coverage concerns selected learning points, not every detail in every linked sentence. Source itself was preserved. CORE priorities were not reduced for obsolete claims.
